recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Revisit only if the work group wants verbatim alignment with the Jira resolution; otherwise the current source already satisfies the issue without adding redundant text.
issue_request: FHIR-22780 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I request to add DomainResource guidance explaining that contained resources must not be used as a shortcut for reducing service calls, are only appropriate for non-independent referenced resources, and that transactions, includes, operations, documents, and messaging are alternatives for multi-resource transport or manipulation.
initial_application: The early FHIR-22780-labeled commit b45913e9990355abbf1dc7ab73da4f425c55d519 did not apply the DomainResource guidance. The substantive application was acbede90b7f03015ad54c2a1383b13d92a6bc6ec, which added the guidance to source/domainresource/domainresource-notes.xml, followed by 49f6c4598b331c158b321cc18935e28aaccff577, which retitled the section to 'Using Contained Resources'.
additional_context: DomainResource is active in source/fhir.ini as an infrastructure resource, and source/domainresource/domainresource-notes.xml is the relevant narrative source. Later edits added additional-resource guidance and did not alter the FHIR-22780 contained-resource substance. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later or conflicting decision for this issue or the same contained/server-call wording.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current notes already prohibit using contained resources to reduce service calls, explain the appropriate non-independent-resource cases, state that contained resources are expected to remain contained, and list the alternatives named in the resolution. The absent exact bridge sentence and 'Implementation note' label are wording differences that do not change implementer understanding.
